description: Run an rclone command — Executes a standard rclone CLI command remotely and streams or returns its output.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

arg.description: Optional positional arguments for the command. Repeat to supply multiple values.

command.description: Name of the rclone command to execute, for example `ls` or `lsf`.

opt.description: Optional command options encoded as a JSON string.

returnType.description: Controls how output is returned; accepts `COMBINED_OUTPUT`, `STREAM`, `STREAM_ONLY_STDOUT`, or `STREAM_ONLY_STDERR`.

name: core_command
